title: ManagedPhrase
description: A pack-owned recall/content item, matching Kotlin ManagedPhrase(id, prompt, meaning, audioAssetId?, register?, context?, credits?). This is the shipped wire shape only: richer internal rights/review tracking (revision, provenance) lives in the pipeline's own editorial authoring records and content/sources/registry.json, never in the manifest itself. IMPORTANT field-direction convention (matches the parent's PhraseEntity projection: PhraseEntity.answer = wire.prompt, PhraseEntity.prompt = wire.meaning): 'prompt' is the TARGET-LANGUAGE text being taught (the expected recall answer, e.g. Shona 'Mhoro'), and 'meaning' is the LEARNER-KNOWN-LANGUAGE gloss/recall cue (e.g. English 'Hello'). Reversing these inverts phrase display end-to-end -- every adapter/build script must map target-language text into 'prompt' and the known-language gloss into 'meaning', never the other way around.

prompt.description: Target-language text being taught (the expected recall answer). Never the learner's known-language gloss -- see the schema-level field-direction convention note above.

meaning.description: Learner-known-language gloss/recall cue for this phrase. Never the target-language text -- see the schema-level field-direction convention note above.
